item.shadowofisraphel.cursed_idol.toolti: Set it down at night... if you dare.
item.shadowofisraphel.cursed_idol.daytim: The idol is cold. It will only stir after dark.
item.shadowofisraphel.cursed_idol.alread: Israphel is already close. You can feel it.
entity.shadowofisraphel.israphel.summone: The shadows gather. Israphel has awoken!
entity.shadowofisraphel.israphel.enraged: Israphel: "You cannot fight the darkness forever!"
entity.shadowofisraphel.israphel.defeate: Israphel: "This is not the end... the shadow always returns..."
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.gift: Ah, a traveller! Here, take my spare hat. Every hero needs a good hat.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line0: Hats! Hats are the answer to most questions.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line1: I'd keep away from the desert after dark. The sand moves.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line2: Have you seen my hat? ...Oh. It's on my head.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line3: They say a man with red eyes walks the land at night.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line4: A Jaffa Cake is a cake. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line5: I once met a dwarf who loved gold more than I love hats. Remarkable.
entity.shadowofisraphel.hat_man.line6: Some idols are best left buried.
